content.text:
At 0.00 s the run report shows a blocking delay: `delay(25)` on line 69 pauses the whole control loop for 25 ms on every pass. During that time nothing reads the sensors or corrects the motors, so the robot only reacts about 38 times a second and weaves across the line (the oscillation warning at 0.5 s).

The fix removes that delay. The motors don't need time to "react": the next pass of loop() simply updates them again. With the delay gone the loop runs every ~1.5 ms and the blocking-delay error disappears on every seed.
